summary: The big seven are gimmes, then the twist: Mississauga and Brampton outrank Vancouver, while Quebec City, Halifax and Victoria cost lives. Clean census data and a deep Blitz; it lands at the easy end of the daily target.
reasons: Casual: 8/10 (the big seven, then Mississauga), but Quebec City #12, Halifax #13, Victoria #66, Regina #24 and Saskatoon #19 took all five lives before Hamilton. Top of the 6-8 band; the par crowd estimate is about 6.8.

Fan: 10/10 in 12 guesses, losing lives only to Quebec City and Surrey (#11, 1,031 behind Hamilton). Values match the 2021 census, still the latest; the prompt says municipalities, so the suburbs are fair.
Blitz: 20 of 24 quick casual names scored; only Whistler, Banff, Yellowknife and Whitehorse are too small. Misspellings like missisauga, calgery and ottwa all land.
fixes: Source row #96, the City of North Vancouver (58,120), is dropped as a same-name duplicate of the District of North Vancouver (#69), so Saint-Hyacinthe, Welland, Belleville and North Bay show #96-#99 instead of #97-#100. Keep the row under a distinct name such as 'North Vancouver (city)', or keep the source ranks.

Optional aliases, currently unrecognized (free in classic, no Blitz points): 'The Six' for Toronto (only 'The 6ix' works), 'YEG' for Edmonton, 'YVR' for Vancouver ('YYC' already works for Calgary), 'Saint Johns' for St. John's.
